### phaseSeparation2d

In this example, the simulation is initialized with a given density plus small, random variation over the domain.
This condition is unstable and leads to liquid-vapor phase separation.
Boundaries are assumed to be periodic.
This example illustrates the usage of multiphase flow models akin to the ones proposed in [@shan_chen:93] in $\OpenLB$.
